rules.unspecified_failure: (?:it|this|that|something|everything|(?:the|my) thing|what i bought) (?:does not work|doesn\'t work|is not working|isn\'t working|stopped working|failed|is broken)
rules.unspecified_problem: (?:something|everything) is wrong(?: with (?:it|this|that|something|everything|(?:the|my) thing|what i bought))?

question: What were you trying to do, and what happened?
rule_application: Entire normalized single message; preserve other clauses, quotes and concrete task context. Existing guarded abstentions cannot be reversed.
gate: Supported accepted and correct accepted counts cannot decrease; incorrect accepted and unsupported suggestions cannot increase. REVIEW withheld must increase. All authored contrast expectations must match. Passing is offline only, not a deployment decision.
boundaries: Designed after inspecting existing 98 provisional development cases.
24 new contrasts are authored examples, not independent labels or a held-out benchmark.
Freeze rules and contrasts before running; do not revise from this run.
Replay only saved guarded control predictions; no training, threshold selection, encoder, private/pending review, validation or test access.
No browser integration, bundle export or calibrated-confidence claim.
